text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
F-Father, aren't you tired?
You just got back from overseas yesterday...
Are you sure it's okay to go out today...?

text_block_list.name: Rice's Father
text_block_list.text:
I'm completely fine! If anything, I've been looking
forward to this so much. Rice, thank you so much
for planning everything out for us.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
No, don't mention it...! The timing's a bit off,
but it's an important "wedding anniversary" celebration...!

text_block_list.name: Rice's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Ufufu. Well then, shall we get going?
It's been so long since we last went to an art museum—

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Kyaah...?!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
...Huh? ...No way!
The tickets blew away...!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
P-Please wait here!
I'll go get them right now...!

text_block_list.name: Rice's Father
text_block_list.text:
Ah...! Honey, let's go after her!
Otherwise, it'll end up like that one time—

text_block_list.name: Rice's Father
text_block_list.text:
"Rice...! I'll get your hat for you,
so hurry and climb down from that tree...!"

text_block_list.name: Young Rice
text_block_list.text:
"I-I'm okay... Rice will get it...! Rice is the bad
one for not wearing it properly, so—"

text_block_list.name: Rice's Mother
text_block_list.text: "Rice-chan...?!"

text_block_list.name: Rice's Mother
text_block_list.text:
You're right, if she pushes herself like back then...! 
Let's hurry, dear...!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: I-I think they blew over this way—
(Ring, ring, ring!)

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: A phone call...? Hello, yes?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
...Eh, the chef fell suddenly ill?! 
Then our reservation... yes... understood...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
W-What should I do... at this rate,
both the museum and dinner will be...

text_block_list.name: Rice's Mother
text_block_list.text: Rice-chan...! Are you alright?!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm so sorry...! 
Not just the tickets, but dinner got cancelled too...!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Because of Rice... your wedding anniversary
celebration is ruined...!

text_block_list.name: Rice's Father
text_block_list.text:
That's not true at all!
Nothing is ruined!

text_block_list.name: Rice's Mother
text_block_list.text:
We can simply buy the tickets again.
And we can look for a new restaurant together.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
N-No...! This is your special day,
Rice doesn't want to cause trouble for you...!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
It's Rice's fault, so Rice has to fix it...! 
So you two should just—

text_block_list.name: Rice's Father
text_block_list.text:
...It's okay to rely on us.
It makes us happier when you do.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Father... but...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
(...In the end, I had them help me out.
Rice really is totally useless...)

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
(...Someday, I'll give them a proper celebration.
For the two people Rice loves most...!)

On my way to the trainer's office,
I spotted Rice Shower with a serious expression.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah, I understand.
We'll go out that day, Father...!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
...This time for sure, I'll make it a wonderful day.
I have to start preparing right away...!
